...RESPONDENTS (BY SMT. RANSA VASANTHI D.L. HCGP., FOR R1  SRI. H.L.PRADEEP KUMAR, ADVOCATE FOR R2 & R3)
 THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO QUASH THE GENERAL AWARD BEARING NO.KIADB/LAQ/1913/2020-21 DTD NIL PASSED BY THE RESPONDENT NO.3 IN RESPECT OF LAND IN SY.NO.127 MEASURING 1 ACRE 30 GUNTAS OF LAND SITUATED AT CHEELURU VILLAGE, MARALAWADI HOBLI, KANAKAPURA TALUK, RAMANAGARA DISTRICT, INSOFAR AS THE PETITIONER IS CONCERNED, WHICH IS PRODUCED AS ANNEXURE-'F'.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER R.DEVDAS J, (ORAL):
Learned High Court Government Pleader takes notice for respondent No.1.

Learned counsel Sri H.L.Pradeep Kumar, has entered appearance for respondents No.2 and 3-KIADB.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is seeking a portion of developed land in terms of the Government Notification dated 23.02.2021 NC: 2023:KHC:29305 and accordingly, a direction may be issued to the respondent-KIADB to consider the representation given by the petitioner.

Learned counsel would further submit that under similar circumstances, a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in W.P. No. 21379/2022 dated 31.01.2023 disposed of the writ petition directing the respondent-KIADB to consider the representation of the petitioners in accordance with law and within a time period.

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that in the said case, the petitioner therein had also sought for a direction to the respondent-KIADB to consider the request made by the petitioners for payment of compensation in terms of Section 29(2) of Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act in terms of the earlier decision in the case of Smt. Rukmani and Another v/s State of Karnataka and Others in WP Nos. 39611- 39612/2016 dated 16.09.2016.

entities.text: Smt. Rukmani and Another v/s State of Karnataka and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel prays for similar reliefs.
Having regard to the orders passed by the Co- ordinate Bench in W.P. No. 21379/2022, this Court is of the considered opinion that similar relief is required to be given to the petitioner.

6. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of permitting the petitioner to give a representation to the respondent-KIADB and the respondent-KIADB shall consider such representation in terms of the directions issued by the Co-ordinate Bench in W.P. No. 21379/2022.
Ordered accordingly.

The entire exercise shall be completed as expeditiously as possible at any rate, within three months from the date when the petitioner gives a representation to the respondent-KIADB.
Sd/-
